title: Living Computation: Robust-first programming in ULAM
summary: Dave Ackley presents robust-first computing and the ULAM programming language for the Movable Feast Machine, a cellular-automata-like architecture. It was a short video for the Future Programming Workshop 2015.
why: HN points to it as an entry into Ackley's indefinitely scalable computing project, with a network-switch demo recommended as the best place to start.

quote.text: I think the best place to start is this demo of a network switch made out of cells
